mapper.select: SELECT `id`, `user_id`, `target_type`, `target_id`, `create_time`, `update_time`, `is_deleted` FROM `favorite` WHERE `is_deleted` = 0 ORDER BY `id` DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT `target_id` FROM `favorite` WHERE `user_id` = #{userId} AND `target_type` = #{targetType} AND `is_deleted` = 0 ORDER BY `id` DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM `favorite` WHERE `user_id` = #{userId} AND `is_deleted` = 0 AND `target_type` = #{targetType}

SELECT * FROM ( SELECT f.`id` AS `favoriteId`, 1 AS `targetType`, d.`id` AS `targetId`, COALESCE(d.`dish_name`, '已删除菜品') AS `targetName`, CONCAT(COALESCE(s.`shop_name`, '已删除档口'), ' · ', COALESCE(c.`canteen_name`, '')) AS `subtitle`, d.`image_url` AS `imageUrl`, d.`price`, s.`id` AS `shopId`, c.`id` AS `canteenId`, f.`create_time` AS `createTime` FROM `favorite` f LEFT JOIN `dish` d ON d.`id` = f.`target_id` LEFT JOIN `shop` s ON s.`id` = d.`shop_id` LEFT JOIN `canteen` c ON c.`id` = s.`canteen_id` WHERE f.`user_id` = #{userId} AND f.`target_type` = 1 AND f.`is_deleted` = 0 AND 1 = 0 UNION ALL SELECT f.`id` AS `favoriteId`, 2 AS `targetType`, s.`id` AS `targetId`, COALESCE(s.`shop_name`, '已删除档口') AS `targetName`, CONCAT(COALESCE(c.`canteen_name`, ''), ' · ', COALESCE(s.`location_desc`, '档口')) AS `subtitle`, s.`cover_url` AS `imageUrl`, s.`avg_price` AS `price`, s.`id` AS `shopId`, c.`id` AS `canteenId`, f.`create_time` AS `createTime` FROM `favorite` f LEFT JOIN `shop` s ON s.`id` = f.`target_id` LEFT JOIN `canteen` c ON c.`id` = s.`canteen_id` WHERE f.`user_id` = #{userId} AND f.`target_type` = 2 AND f.`is_deleted` = 0 AND 1 = 0 ) `favorite_items` ORDER BY `createTime` DESC, `favoriteId` DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
